Privacy Policy

Last Updated: April 3, 2026

Introduction

Welcome to Cashi Flow. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This policy explains how we treat your data when you use our mobile application.

1. Information We Collect

Cashi Flow is designed as a local-first financial ledger. Most of your data stays exactly where it belongs: on your device.

  • Financial Records: Transactions, account balances, and category information are stored locally in an encrypted database on your phone.
  • AI Interactions: If you choose to use the AI parsing features, the text of your notifications or manual entries is processed to identify financial details.
  • Device Permissions: We request access to notifications and battery optimization purely to automate record entry from your banking apps.

2. How We Use Information

We use the information collected solely to provide the core functionality of the app:

  • To maintain your personal financial ledger.
  • To provide insights and analytics on your spending.
  • To automate transaction entry via notification listening.

3. Third-Party Services

Cashi Flow integrates with the following third-party services:

  • Google Gemini AI: When using AI parsing, data is sent to Google's Gemini API for processing. Please refer to Google's Privacy Policy regarding their AI services.
  • UPI Applications: The app interacts with your installed UPI apps for payments. We do not access your bank credentials or PINs.

4. Data Storage and Security

Because your data is stored locally, you are in control of its security. We provide tools to:

  • Manually export backups in JSON format to your chosen directory.
  • Completely wipe all data from the app settings.

We do not maintain any cloud servers or databases that store your financial history.

5. Changes to This Policy

We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date.
